name: Kurzen's Head
summary: Kurzen’s Head is proof sought by the rebels at their camp in Stranglethorn Vale. Lieutenant Doren needs it to learn whether Colonel Kurzen’s command has been broken.

sections.title: Proof for Doren
sections.body: Lieutenant Doren waits at Rebel Camp for word from the Stockpile, where Colonel Kurzen commands his men. The rebels face Kurzen’s Elite and Subchiefs as well as the Colonel himself. Doren asks for Kurzen’s Head as proof that the enemy leaders have been defeated. His band’s safety rests on the answer.

faq.answer: Lieutenant Doren at Rebel Camp asks for Kurzen’s Head as proof that Colonel Kurzen and his leaders are defeated.
Colonel Kurzen commands his men from deep within the Stockpile in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why do the rebels need Kurzen’s Head?
faq.answer: The rebels need Kurzen’s Head as proof that Colonel Kurzen and his leaders have been defeated.
Lieutenant Doren calls Kurzen a cruel and formidable commander whose men threaten the rebel band.

faq.q: What happens when Kurzen is defeated?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Doren says Kurzen’s defeat saves the rebel band and lets them breathe easier.
